events.title: Waters stock slips after earnings beat and guidance holds
events.summary: Waters Corp (WAT) stock experienced a slight dip despite beating earnings expectations for the latest quarter, reporting $1.65 billion in revenue and $3.05 EPS against an expected $1.62 billion and $3.01 respectively. The company also issued Q3 and FY 2026 EPS guidance, which, while competitive, did not prevent the stock from trading lower. The market's focus remains on whether Waters can sustain growth and improve its narrow profitability margins, especially given its high P/E ratio.

articles.headline: Waters stock slips after earnings beat and guidance holds

events.title: Private Equity's Return to Oil, Gas and Coal Already Tops All of 2025, Driven by One $9.7B Deal
events.summary: Private equity investments in the oil, gas, and coal sectors have significantly surpassed the total for all of 2025, largely due to a $9.7 billion acquisition by KKR & Co. and Energy Capital Partners. This surge, totaling $14.7 billion through July, is attributed to rising commodity prices, energy supply concerns, and increased electricity demand from data centers and AI. Europe accounted for the majority of this investment as it seeks to reduce reliance on Russian natural gas.

articles.headline: Private Equity's Return to Oil, Gas and Coal Already Tops All of 2025, Driven by One $9.7B Deal

events.title: Is ONEOK (OKE) Fully Valued On Strong Q2 Earnings And A Higher 2026 Outlook?
events.summary: ONEOK (OKE) recently hit a 52-week high after strong Q2 earnings, an updated 2026 outlook, and a higher price target from Morgan Stanley. Despite this, Simply Wall St's analysis suggests the stock is currently 2% overvalued with a fair value of $95.48 against its last close of $97.07. While its P/E ratio is below the fair ratio and peer average, it remains above the industry level, leading to a mixed valuation outlook.

articles.headline: Is ONEOK (OKE) Fully Valued On Strong Q2 Earnings And A Higher 2026 Outlook?

events.title: Elevance Health stock trades around $400 as Q2 2026 earnings beat supports upbeat outlook
events.summary: Elevance Health stock is trading around $400, supported by a strong Q2 2026 earnings beat with adjusted EPS of $7.45 against a $6.21 consensus. The company reported modest revenue growth, but profit expansion outpaced top-line growth, leading to an upbeat full-year EPS forecast of $27.07 for 2026. Analysts maintain a "Buy to Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $440.90, indicating potential upside despite a slight membership decline.

articles.headline: Elevance Health stock trades around $400 as Q2 2026 earnings beat supports upbeat outlook

events.title: Goldman Sachs reiterates Progressive stock rating on July earnings beat
events.summary: Goldman Sachs has reiterated its Buy rating and $230.00 price target for Progressive Corp. (NYSE:PGR) after the company reported strong July operating results, beating analyst estimates for earnings per share and net premiums written growth. The insurance company's Personal Auto segment showed robust performance with an 86.7% combined ratio, and InvestingPro's Fair Value analysis suggests the stock is currently undervalued. This positive outlook comes despite recent broader market concerns about slowing policy growth and competitive pressures in the auto insurance sector.

articles.headline: Goldman Sachs reiterates Progressive stock rating on July earnings beat

events.title: Citi Turns Bullish on Zambia Debt as Election Heralds Upgrades
events.summary: Citigroup Inc. is taking a bullish stance on Zambia's bonds following the recent election of President Hakainde Hichilema, anticipating credit upgrades for the copper-producing nation. Citi strategists recommend buying Zambia's domestic seven-year notes at an upcoming auction and are going overweight on the country's credit. This outlook suggests renewed confidence in Zambia's economic future after the political transition.

articles.headline: Citi Turns Bullish on Zambia Debt as Election Heralds Upgrades

events.title: Strong ONEOK stock trades near a new 52-week high as guidance and demand support the rally
events.summary: ONEOK Inc. (OKE) stock is trading near its 52-week high in mid-August 2026, driven by strong Q2 2026 earnings, increased full-year guidance, and growing demand for natural gas from AI data centers. The company reported a 13% increase in net income and a 7% rise in adjusted EBITDA in Q2, leading to an upward revision of its 2026 outlook. Analysts have reacted positively, with some raising price targets, as the stock has significantly outperformed the market year-to-date with a gain of over 30%.

articles.headline: Strong ONEOK stock trades near a new 52-week high as guidance and demand support the rally

events.title: Morgan Stanley downgrades Diamondback Energy stock rating on valuation
events.summary: Morgan Stanley has downgraded Diamondback Energy (NASDAQ:FANG) from Overweight to Equalweight, setting a price target of $216.00, citing valuation concerns despite the company being a premier U.S. shale operator. Analyst Devin McDermott noted that the stock's valuation is in-line with peers but offers less free cash flow growth, with spending expected to rise in 2027. This downgrade comes even as Diamondback Energy recently reported strong Q2 2026 results and has seen a 42% gain year-to-date, trading near its 52-week high.

articles.headline: Morgan Stanley downgrades Diamondback Energy stock rating on valuation

events.title: Tariff refunds of nearly $1B help Target beat Street in strong Q2
events.summary: Target (TGT) reported strong second-quarter results, driven by nearly $1 billion in tariff refunds and the continued success of its turnaround program. The company's net earnings doubled and adjusted EPS significantly beat Wall Street estimates. Target also raised its full-year guidance, reflecting confidence in its strategic initiatives and continued growth in sales.

articles.headline: Tariff refunds of nearly $1B help Target beat Street in strong Q2

events.title: Why Edison International (EIX) Is Up 5.4% After Q2 Earnings Beat And Reaffirmed 2026 Guidance
events.summary: Edison International (EIX) saw its stock rise 5.4% after reporting Q2 2026 earnings above analyst forecasts and reaffirming its full-year guidance of US$5.90 to US$6.20 per share. Despite these positive results and a lifted annual dividend, analysts maintain a "Hold" rating due to ongoing wildfire and regulatory risks in California. The company's investment narrative hinges on regulated grid investment and electrification outweighing these persistent challenges, with wildfire cost recovery clarity remaining a key short-term catalyst.

articles.headline: Why Edison International (EIX) Is Up 5.4% After Q2 Earnings Beat And Reaffirmed 2026 Guidance

events.title: Avery Dennison stock trades around $178 as strong Q2 2026 results and board changes shape the outloo
events.summary: Avery Dennison's stock is trading around $178 after reporting stronger-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings of $2.89 per share on $2.5 billion in revenue, beating analyst forecasts. The company also announced leadership changes, including William Wagner as the new board chair, which, combined with solid cash generation, has contributed to a positive market reaction. Despite the strong performance, the stock remains below the consensus analyst price target of $201.22, suggesting potential for further upside.

articles.headline: Avery Dennison stock trades around $178 as strong Q2 2026 results and board changes shape the outloo

events.title: Target boosts 2026 outlook after Q2 sales and earnings beat
events.summary: Target (NYSE:TGT) has increased its full-year 2026 outlook following better-than-expected second-quarter results, with sales up 5.3% to $26.54 billion and adjusted EPS of $4.11, exceeding analyst estimates. The company saw strong growth across all merchandise categories, driven by digital sales and same-day delivery, and has raised its net sales growth and operating income margin rate projections for the full year. Target also increased its full-year GAAP and adjusted EPS guidance, largely due to tariff refund benefits.

articles.headline: Target boosts 2026 outlook after Q2 sales and earnings beat

events.title: Massachusetts governor warn NextEra-Dominion merger could hike energy costs
events.summary: Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey and Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell are opposing the proposed merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy, citing concerns about potential increases in electricity costs, reduced market competition, and risks to grid reliability. Five New England states, excluding New Hampshire, have urged federal regulators to scrutinize the deal, which would consolidate ownership of the region's two remaining nuclear power plants. State officials highlighted NextEra's past actions, including efforts to block a transmission line and attempts to pass costs to ratepayers, as reasons for their opposition.

articles.headline: Massachusetts governor warn NextEra-Dominion merger could hike energy costs

events.title: Analog Devices Q3 2026 earnings beat on AI data center demand
events.summary: Analog Devices reported record fiscal third-quarter revenue of $4.02 billion, a 40% year-over-year increase, surpassing analyst expectations due to strong demand for data center and industrial chips, particularly driven by AI infrastructure. The company also provided a record outlook for Q4 and announced the acquisition of Empower Semiconductor for $1.5 billion to enhance its position in AI power delivery.

articles.headline: Analog Devices Q3 2026 earnings beat on AI data center demand

events.title: Target (NYSE: TGT) nearly doubles Q2 EPS as tariff refunds hit
events.summary: Target (NYSE: TGT) reported robust Q2 2026 results, with net sales growing 5.3% to $26.5 billion and EPS doubling to $4.11, significantly boosted by $994 million in pretax tariff refunds. Excluding these refunds, EPS still increased by 20%. The company also raised its full-year 2026 guidance, expecting net sales growth of around 5% and GAAP and Adjusted EPS of $9.90–$10.90, including the tariff benefit.

articles.headline: Target (NYSE: TGT) nearly doubles Q2 EPS as tariff refunds hit
